name: @pipeworx/mcp-met-no

tools.name: forecast
tools.description: Compact 10-day forecast (temperature, precip, wind, cloud, humidity).

altitude.description: Meters above sea level (optional, improves accuracy).

tools.name: nowcast
tools.description: 90-minute precipitation nowcast (Nordics only — outside region returns sparse data).

tools.name: sunrise
tools.description: Sunrise / sunset / moon events for a date.

areaclass.description: grunnkrets | delomraade | kommune | fylke | land (default grunnkrets)

tools.name: oceanforecast
tools.description: Ocean forecast — current, wave height, sea temperature.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-met-no forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the met-no pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
